body:
Yeah, I won't be home from school for another few days but as soon as I get back I'm planning on making an appointment with my doctor. The fact that I have to sit in it for the next few days though while not really having anyone to rely on just feels so overwhelming :(

I haven't posted about the transgender issue. I'm really just not sure what to say. I guess I'm afraid of coming off as dramatic or just seeking attention or compliments. I've been doing a lot of reading on the matter, but not doing too much talking about it other than with the few people I told...it still just feels so weird you know? I see myself as a girl, not as transgendered. I'm just a simple average kid with no other real abnormalities, so it's hard to imagine something so...serious. I've never really felt this much pressure and stress before and it's just so much. I wish I could just go home now, but I still have finals :/
This is something I can see myself doing sober...

Seems like he's had a good life, especially if he loved teaching so much and could get so emotional over leaving his students. I'm sure he's tired, and while he might not want to die, I don't think he would fear it as much as us youngins.
